prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one opaque full-bleed native game-map detail square. Image1 gives EXACT framing, scale, geometry and object footprints forr09_c10/r03_c03. The left and top neighboring reference band(s) each use first115 pixels as strict native context. Keep those source grooves, bevels, contours, scale and shadow endpoints exact. The following115 pixels (indices115..229) are guide-only halo softly transitioned into regional context; complete them coherently, without reproducing a compositing band as artwork. At a shared corner, the top/north strict source takes precedence. Never turn guide tone differences, straight compositing bounds, or softened reference edges into walls, steps, extra paving blocks, foliage edges, new shadows, or broken grooves. Reconstruct only the soft interior into crisp real hand-painted detail at matching scale. Do not move, crop, rotate, enlarge or recompose anything. Image2 is the user-confirmed PRIMARY painting/material reference: bright, clean, rounded, full-bodied Daoist chibi fantasy, readable smooth bevels and restrained low-contrast painterly surfaces. Copy no UI, words, floral ornaments, characters, lighting or objects from Image2. Inventory is determined only by Image1: retain only its existing materials, objects, foliage and shadows. A stone-only target must remain stone only. No added plants, flowers, gray paving blocks, walls, objects, stains or cast shadows. Quiet clean stone: no grit, cracks, veins, spotted noise, exaggerated brush patches, blur or sharpening halos. Keep existing leaves rounded and clean. No new buildings, circles, stairs, medallions, symbols, characters, frames, labels or watermark. Return only the single native1254-square detail image at highest available fidelity.
Actual crop: keep only the existing gray stone bridge side spanning this view: upper railing with its single long rounded opening and existing inset vertical posts; large curved arch face across the lower right; original radial masonry joints; cropped pale foreground railing post at lower-left. All these gray structures and existing recessed panels are required. There are no shrubs, flowers, new posts, water ripples or lanterns to add here. Keep the smooth arch curvature, post silhouettes, aperture shape and masonry joints exactly at their current positions. Paint broad gray surfaces with restrained soft shading and only very subtle brushwork, no extra cracks, scratches, veins, grids, dark blotches or pale scored lines. Fix the reference's soft overlap halos into coherent uninterrupted contour edges without following guide bands as geometry. Image1 alone controls structure. The entire composition is the same close crop; do not draw the whole bridge.
